tasks.original_prompt:
ED follow-up audit for this patient: last emergency visit date, first clinic visit after it and the gap in days, whether it met 30 days, and the measurements from that clinic visit, plus the ED note.
Context: patient MRN SYN-f3e6ecfc35 (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2021-03-16, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The ED visit is the most recent Encounter with class code EMER, status finished and a period start on or before the as-of date. The follow-up visit is the earliest Encounter with class code AMB and status finished whose period start date is after the ED visit's start date, at most 90 days after it, and on or before the as-of date; when there is none, followup_date and days_to_followup are null, within_30_days is false and measurements is empty. answer is {"ed_visit_date": ..., "followup_date": ..., "days_to_followup": ..., "within_30_days": ..., "measurements": [...]}. The dates are period start dates (YYYY-MM-DD); days_to_followup (integer) is the number of days between them; within_30_days (boolean) is days_to_followup <= 30. measurements has one entry for every Observation whose encounter references the follow-up Encounter and has a valueQuantity, and one for every component with a valueQuantity of such an Observation (a blood pressure panel gives systolic and diastolic), sorted by code, each with exactly these keys: code (string: the first code.coding code of the Observation or component), date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit). evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (both Encounters, the DocumentReference whose context references the ED Encounter, and each listed Observation), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.

Reply with only JSON: {"answer": {days_to_followup: number, ed_visit_date: date YYYY-MM-DD, followup_date: date YYYY-MM-DD, measurements: list of {code: text, date: date YYYY-MM-DD, unit: text, value: number}, within_30_days: true/false}, "evidence": [references of the records you used, Type/id]}. Use null for any value the chart does not have.
